mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dot includes the left endpoint (−5, 2) in the function graph. Right image: The dot specifies the actual red-graph function value at x = 1.
Rationales: The feature marks an endpoint included in the plotted branch in the left image and specifies an isolated included ordered pair off the nearby curve in the right image. The filled cyan point at (−5, 2), where the curve ends on the left. The solid red point below the open point at x = 1.
